inner.headline: The one who reads every word of the newsletter.
inner.body: Including the footnotes. Occasionally replies with corrections.

inner.headline: The one who has never opened it.
inner.body: Still somehow knows exactly when the pool opens.

inner.headline: The one who texts the golf pro directly.
inner.body: About everything. Including the dinner menu.

inner.headline: The one who asks at the bar.
inner.body: Every time. Because a person is right there.

close.headline: Every one of them deserves an answer.
close.body: On the channel they use, whichever one that is.

caption:
Every club has this cast. The newsletter reader, the member who never opens a thing, the one who texts the pro about dinner, and the one who waits to ask at the bar.

None of them are doing it wrong. They are just reachable in different places.

The clubs that answer each of them where they already are tend to be the ones members call easy.
firstComment: Which one did you picture first?

earnsItsPlace: Recognition of the members every operator knows, pointed at the problem Club Pilot solves: each of them is reachable in a different place.
humorMechanism: Recognition: nobody is wrong, and every operator sees their own members in each slide.
